title: Orlando Furioso
author: Lodovico Ariosto
description: "Orlando Furioso" by Ludovico Ariosto is an epic poem published in its complete form in 1532.
longDescription: This sweeping tale unfolds during the war between Charlemagne's Christian paladins and invading Saracen forces.

authorInfo.bio: Lodovico Ariosto (1474–1533) wrote Orlando Furioso. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
authorInfo.edition: Complete historical source edition, with original credits and licence retained.
